comment: Optional hook tuning, TEAM-SHARED (committed). Every key is optional — leave one out for its default: "taskCoreEveryEdits" (25; 0 disables), "northStarAnchorEvery" (25 calls; 0 disables the anchor), "northStarAnchorEveryTokens" (40000 — the full anchor follows context growth; 0 falls back to the call count), "northStarAnchorMaxLines" (80), "consultNudge" (true), "minionModel" ("sonnet"), "driftRefreshThreshold" (8; 0 disables drift counting), "sourceExts" (an array that narrows which extensions count as source; the built-in polyglot default is in hook-helpers.mjs). For PER-MACHINE overrides that shouldn't be committed, create a gitignored .bearing/hooks.local.json with the same shape — it wins over this file.
